defects.cause: The edge reboot left nginx pointing to port 8610 while the QAZ.FUND containers were absent.
defects.fix: Backed up and checksummed PostgreSQL, Qdrant and semantic state, rebuilt exact SHA 171d43e and restored only QAZ.FUND services over preserved volumes.
defects.proof: Public and runtime release identity match 171d43e; /ready, worker heartbeat, semantic index and production smoke are healthy.

defects.cause: The primary applicant path was implicit; comparison and exports existed without catalog-owned selection and actions.
defects.fix: Made find, verify, compare, prepare and export/share the semantic journey and restored bounded compare, CSV, ICS and share actions.
defects.proof: Product decision record, focused tests, 119-cell browser matrix and real compare/export interaction checks.

defects.cause: A source parser emitted 56 usable rows but three detail timeouts caused the entire run to be recorded as error with no useful detail.
defects.fix: Classify non-zero output with a fetch error as partial, preserve a bounded reason and expose it as watch/attention while keeping the records usable.
defects.proof: QazData ledger validates; scheduler, recorder, coverage, status and operator tests pass; schema digest remains unchanged.

defects.cause: Fifty URL duplicate excess rows share UNDP or EBRD listing pages, while eleven normalized-title excess rows require source context.
defects.fix: Reviewed aggregate groups and retained distinct notices; a shared listing URL is not treated as proof that programmes are duplicates.
defects.proof: QazData uniqueness evidence records the reviewed counts and preserves source attribution.

defects.cause: The browser-only preparation page loaded ordinary-page analytics helpers, contradicting the local-only data boundary.
defects.fix: Removed all analytics helpers from preparation and clarified localStorage, deletion, ordinary-page analytics and source-license boundaries in RU, KK and EN.
defects.proof: KZ compliance bundle validates; tests reject GA, Metrika and Clarity on preparation; targeted browser edit produced localStorage only and zero requests.

defects.cause: Exact controller, consent, transfer and retention treatment for the production GA4, Yandex Webvisor and Clarity configuration depends on provider settings and legal interpretation.
defects.route_or_source: ordinary public pages only; preparation excluded
defects.fix: Kept the issue narrow and documented; no claim of legal approval is made.

defects.cause: Workflow and relevance wording could be read as QAZ.FUND confirming eligibility or prediction precision.
defects.route_or_source: catalog, comparison, preparation and public explanatory copy in RU, KK and EN
defects.fix: Changed fit language to shortlist language, tightened relevance explanations and preserved organizer authority.
defects.proof: Exact EdPol scan has zero matches; five heuristic candidates were context-reviewed as false positives; receipt verdict is pass.

defects.cause: Data-route grid children retained min-content width and overflowed the 320 px viewport.
defects.fix: Allowed cards and metadata to shrink and wrap; enabled compact header wrapping.
defects.proof: The original failing matrix cell now has no overflow; the 119-cell matrix is green.

defects.cause: Swagger version metadata inherited a 3.59:1 contrast combination, and the docs header used an unowned radial glow and blur.
defects.fix: Applied opaque AVDS surfaces, border and text tokens and removed the decorative gradient/blur.
defects.proof: All seven docs cells pass axe; anti-generative and visual-craft validators pass.

defects.cause: The full route/state/viewport denominator and browser-only privacy proof were too narrow for release acceptance.
defects.route_or_source: 17 canonical surfaces, seven widths, locales, 404 and preparation
defects.fix: Expanded deterministic browser acceptance to 119 cells and added nine targeted locale, privacy, focus, touch and 404 checks.
defects.proof: 119/119 matrix cells and 9/9 targeted checks pass locally.

defects.cause: The production semantic service was raised to a measured 5 GiB limit in 171d43e, but its deploy-contract test still asserted the obsolete 3 GiB value.
defects.fix: Aligned the test with the existing measured runtime contract; no production resource limit was changed.
defects.proof: The focused deploy-contract test and repeated full ci-fast gate pass.

defects.cause: A production detail record with long source content expanded the implicit article grid track to 332 px inside a 300 px mobile shell; public CDN hydration also exceeded the fixture's fixed 400 ms wait.
defects.fix: Bound the article grid with minmax(0, 1fr) and zero-width minima; wait for semantic H1 and compare controls instead of assuming fixed hydration time.
defects.proof: Injected candidate CSS reduces the same production page from 342 px to 323 px document width; full tests pass and the final live matrix must be repeated after the hotfix release.

defects.proof: Closure requires the approved schema, manifest validation and matching public registry identity.
